node.statement: For every fixed index i and coordinate l, max(-(w_i(l)-w_k(l)),0) = max(-w_i(l)+w_k(l),0) <= max(-w_i(l),0)+max(w_k(l),0). Indeed, if -w_i(l)+w_k(l) <= 0 then the left side is 0, and if -w_i(l)+w_k(l) > 0 then -w_i(l)+w_k(l) is bounded by the sum of the positive parts max(-w_i(l),0) and max(w_k(l),0).
